lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in at least three discernible horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, forming a grid-like spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to create distinct anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a strong vertical luminance gradient with peak intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A triangular notch is visible on the posterior trailing margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a high density of high-luminance spots; the cephalic region exhibits a high-density field of smaller spots transitioning into the more structured lateral grid.
